title: osf work-tracker CLI: read Ready, report state + recap
summary: Adds an `osf work-tracker` command group with two subcommands. `ready` builds a real GitHub Project adapter from a new `[work_tracker]` table in `osf.toml` and reads the single item marked Ready, printing it as JSON or text. `report` parses a state (and a cause for blocked), reads a recap file, and writes the state then the recap back to the tracker. The change is mostly wiring: a new config reader, a thin command-logic module, CLI argument plumbing in `main.rs`, and integration tests that pin the usage-error contract without touching a real project.

nodes.summary: New module that glues config to the tracker. Builds a GitHubWorkTrackerConfig from `[work_tracker]`, exposes `ready` and `report`, and parses `--state`/`--cause` and the provider-qualified item id. Refuses an empty recap before touching the tracker.

nodes.summary: Reads the `[work_tracker]` table from `<root>/osf.toml` into a deny-unknown-fields struct with owner, project_number, and defaulted status_field (`Status`) and skip_status (`Done`). Returns None when the file or table is absent.
